_comment: Which Nexus file slot each release asset is uploaded to. Read by .github/workflows/publish-to-nexus.yml.
These ids are public on the mod page, so they are checked in rather than hidden in a secret. Only
the API key is a secret. Find them under Manage Files, or by turning on Advanced on the public
page: the mod id is the number in the page URL, and each file carries its own id.
The upload action adds a new version to a slot that already exists. It cannot create the mod page
or the slot, so all three have to be uploaded by hand once before any of this runs. A file_id left
at 0 stops the workflow with a message rather than uploading nowhere.
asset is the release asset's name without the version and the .zip; the workflow forms
AS2ModApi-0.2.2.zip from it and the tag.
Exactly one entry sets changelog and update_mod_version. All three slots live on one mod page, so
two entries claiming either would post the same changelog twice and set the page version twice.
primary_mod_manager_download decides which file Vortex fetches when somebody presses the mod
manager download button on the page. Leave every entry false to keep whatever the page is already
set to; setting it here overrides that on the next release.
